services.name: Boat Rentals Info
services.desc: We offer a variety of sports including wake boarding, skiing, surfing, and tubing and we would love to teach you how to do them all! Bring up to 8 people (10 max, but $50 per person over 8 people), your family young to old, business retreat, first-timers to experts. As long as you're willing, we would love to teach you. The captain has been teaching people for years. He has taught grandmas, 5 year olds, and everything in between. Bring your swimsuits, towels, sunscreen, and yourself ready to have fun! You may bring life jackets that work for you or any skis or wake boards if you would rather use your own. Otherwise the captiain will provide those for you At Leisure Fun you’ll find
